verdict.rationale: Gmail API docs show broad parity for core actions—sending, reading, searching, labeling/filtering, and push notifications (gmail-docs-1,17,18,20,25,21,27,28)—but several prominent UI features (snooze, undo send, offline mode, Gemini-powered summarize/organize/suggested replies) are documented only as UI capabilities with no corresponding API endpoint in the pack, and community evidence notes IMAP-based interoperability is degraded compared to native UI behavior (gmail-comm-1, gmail-comm-2). missing for 10: API-exposed snooze/undo-send, API access to Gemini summarize/organize/draft features, and independent confirmation of full read/write parity for UI-only actions.
